readability.reads_as: a strip turn and a lift with a toss: the dig is missing
readability.note: The TCP only goes up: 0.55 -> 0.66 m through 'takes it up' and 'tips it down, digs in' (0-2.2 s), scoops 0.66 -> 0.78 m, the toss at 5.6-6.2 s (0.68 m/s), settles. The dig's lower end is clamped: end_z 0.2 = STRIP_FLOOR_M (the hub's tool tip at 0.55 m less the 0.35-0.65 m depth is under it), so the strip's lower end only reaches 0.15-0.24 m and the tool never dips. dig_deg 29.1 (the steep design set). The only scoop in the library (greet and high made none).

awkward.evidence: isolated J5 accel spike ~65 % (neighbours < 30 %); twitches J2 1, J4 1 (reversals under 0.6 deg)

audience.note: From AUDIENCE SIDE the strip fans at ~45-60 deg and lifts; the scoop is meant to read in profile and nothing in the views shows a shovel digging.

suggestions.target: shows/party.json hubs.low.tcp (z, metres) and zones.low center z
suggestions.change: hubs.low.tcp z 0.55 -> ~0.70 (zones.low center z 0.62 -> ~0.77); every low clip is redrawn
suggestions.why: the dig is floor-bound: from 0.70 m the strip's lower end can go 0.5 m under the tool tip before STRIP_FLOOR_M, so the tool tips down and digs instead of only lifting

needs_live_check: whether the strip reads as a shovel in profile in 3D
